title: SwitchMLP expert parameters never updated with distributed optimizer
root_cause: Expert params fall back to non-distributed optimizer with no gradient all-reduce in the expert data parallel group. Each rank updates expert params with local-only gradients, causing params to diverge across ranks.
invariant: Expert params must be identical across ranks in the same expert DP subgroup. More distinct hash values than EP size = divergence.
fixed_behavior: All parameters including experts are properly updated by the optimizer
notes: This commit lacks --mock-data CLI arg but pretrain_gpt.py supports mock=True. detect.py injects the argument.
